# ug-lua-llm agent reference

ug-lua-llm is a dependency-light Lua 5.1–5.4 client for OpenAI, Claude, Gemini,
Grok, Groq, OpenRouter, Ollama, DeepSeek, Mistral, and arbitrary
OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions endpoints.

## Install and import

    git clone https://github.com/unabated-games/ug-lua-llm.git
    cd ug-lua-llm
    luarocks make ug-lua-llm-0.1.1-1.rockspec

    local llm = require "ug-lua-llm"
    local client = llm.new("openai", {
      api_key = os.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY"),
      model = "gpt-5.6-terra",
    })

Supported provider names: openai, claude, gemini, grok, groq, openrouter,
ollama, deepseek, mistral, openai-compatible.

For custom endpoints prefer:

    local client = llm.openai_compatible({
      base_url = "http://localhost:8000/v1",
      model = "my-model",
      api_key = os.getenv("LLM_API_KEY"), -- optional
      headers = {},                       -- optional
      capabilities = { streaming = true, tools = false, models = true },
    })

For local Ollama use `llm.new("ollama", { model = "llama3.2" })`; its default
base URL is http://localhost:11434/v1 and authentication is optional.

## Core contract

Messages are `{ role = "system"|"user"|"assistant"|"tool", content = ... }`.
Every operation returns `result, err, details`. On failure result is nil, err is
human-readable, and optional details describes kind, provider, status, code,
retryability, safe headers, and sanitized body.

Normalized responses expose these fields where available: text, tool_calls,
usage, model, finish_reason, provider, raw. Do not parse provider wire formats
when a normalized field exists. Use raw only for provider-specific data.

Client methods:

- chat(messages, options)
- complete(prompt, options)
- chat_with_tools(messages, tools, options)
- stream_chat(messages, callback, options)
- stream_complete(prompt, callback, options)
- stream_chat_with_tools(messages, tools, callback, options)
- list_models(options)
- capabilities()
- response(input, options): OpenAI Responses only
- interaction(input, options): Gemini Interactions only

Streaming callbacks receive `(delta, full)`. Prefer `delta.content` or
`delta.text`. Deltas may also carry tool_calls, finish_reason, provider, raw.

Tool definitions use `{ name, description, parameters = <JSON Schema> }`.
Parse calls with `llm.Tool.parse_tool_calls(response)`. Each parsed call has id,
name, decoded arguments when valid, type, and raw. Use `llm.ToolRegistry` for
handler registration and automatic execution.

Embeddings: `llm.Embeddings.new(provider, config):embed(input, options)` supports
OpenAI, Gemini, Mistral, Ollama, and DeepSeek.

## Safe implementation rules

- Check errors; do not assume a response exists.
- Do not log keys, Authorization headers, payload secrets, or `.env` contents.
- Inspect `client:capabilities()` before selecting optional features.
- Treat custom endpoint capabilities as declarations, then run
  `LLM_BASE_URL=... LLM_MODEL=... lua scripts/conformance.lua` to verify them.
- Pass model explicitly when reproducibility matters.
- Keep `/v1` in common Ollama and OpenAI-compatible base URLs.
- Use `lua scripts/doctor.lua` when installed rocks cannot be required.

See docs/index.md for human documentation and examples/README.md for runnable
programs.
